name: Draw and Guess
summary: Draw and Guess is a drawing and word-guessing party game played in a web browser on the Boardit site, for two to twelve players who join one table with a short room code. On each turn one player picks one of a few secret words and draws it on a shared canvas, without writing the word, while everyone else types guesses into the chat. A right guess is hidden from the others and scores points, and a guess one letter off tells only that player they are close. Earlier guesses score more, and every player who guessed before you lowers your share; the drawer is paid for how quickly the table read the drawing. The dashes show the word length and letters are revealed as the clock runs down. Everyone draws once per round, and the most points after the last round wins.
